title: Old Blue Animated Totem
description: Animates the old blue totem of undying
body:
Do you want new colors in your game? **Try** out this unique old animated totem of undying!

---

![Old Blue Animated Totem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f4f749ef8d9c824b2f30a09ec94aa11c4695ad36.gif)

---

If you want to change the animation speed, then open the **totem_of_undying.png.mcmeta** file along this path 
```
assets/minecraft/textures/item/totem_of_undying.png.mcmeta
```
 and enter any number here 
 
```
"frametime": 7
```

---

If you want the totem to be small, then download "mini items" and "small totem pop".
